THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENTAND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this"Agreement"), made as of January 5 2022 by and between 64 Grove Street, LLC , having an address at 812 Napoleon Street,Woodmere,NY 11598 (hereinafterreferred to as"Owner") and Bushwick Corner LLC, having an address at 2001 57th Street, Brooklyn, NY 11204 (hereinafter referred toas"Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of Brooklyn, County of Kings and State of New York, known as and by the street address 64 Grove Street and the tax lot Block 3322,Lot 4 and more particularly described inExhibit A-l. annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hercinafter referred to as"Owner'sProperty"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title or contract purchaser of a certain parce! of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of Brooklyn, County of Kings and State of New York, known as and by the street addresses 1001 Bushwick Avenue, Brooklyn, New York and the tax lot Block 3322, Lot 1 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lots being refcrred to herein as "Developer's Land"; the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the "ExistingDeveloper Building"; WHEREAS,Developer intends, to construct a new building or modify or alter the existing building upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new building or modification of the existing building, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Developer's Property"); Owner's Land and Developer's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a"Parcel"); WHEREAS,it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"),as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the "Zoning Resolution") than is now availabie for use under the"floor area ratio"limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to Developer's Land as an independent "zoning lot",with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Land and

Owner's Land into a single"zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Buildingwithsuchlimitation; WHEREAS,there exist Floor Area DevelopmentRights(hereinafter defined)which are appurtenant to Owner's Land which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Owner's Building (hereinafter,“Excess Floor Area Development Rights") and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution.As used in this Agreement, the term "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution,which are appurtenant to a zoninglot,to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a totalfloor area determined by(i)multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district inwhich such zoning lot is located,(i) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoninglot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution including the right to use Owner's Property for purposes of calculating inclusionary rights available to Developer's Property under section 23-90 of the Zoning Resolution, (ii) all Floor Area Development Rights pertaining to Owner's Property resultingfrom an upward revision on or after the date hereof byNewYork City of the allowable floor area ratio and/or the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density or other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution that become availablc to Owner's Property after the date hereof, and (iv) the inclusion of further any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York (the "City"); WHEREAS,in order toconstruct theNewBuildingwith theexcess bulk onDeveloper's Land, Developer is hereby acquiring the Available Development Rights (hereinafter defined) from Owner's Land.
